title: Armour Texture Toggle
description: This Mod make Armour texture invisible by pressing a key which is very helpfull to make intro in smp without any fear of death so u will be able to create your intros without fear
body:
Armour Texture Toggle  

Want to see your Minecraft skin without sacrificing protection?  

Armour Texture Toggle is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that allows you to hide the visual rendering of your equipped armor while keeping all armor functionality intact.  

Features  

✅ Hide equipped armor with a single key press  
✅ Keep all armor protection and enchantments  
✅ Works in first-person and third-person views  
✅ Armor remains equipped and fully functional  
✅ Client-side only — no server installation required  
✅ Lightweight and performance-friendly  
✅ Saves your preference between game launches  

How It Works  

When enabled, the mod prevents your armor from being rendered on your client. Your armor is still equipped, still provides protection, and still works exactly as normal.  

You see:  

Your skin  
No visible armor  

The server sees:  

Full armor equipped  

Other players see:  

Full armor equipped  
Default Keybind  

H — Toggle armor visibility  

Armor Hidden  
Armor Visible  


Perfect For  
PvP players  
Content creators  
Skin showcases  
Screenshot creators  
Players who want to see their skin while staying protected  

Hide your armor. Keep your protection. See your skin. 🔥
